production_rule: Templates show the geometric symbol master, generated from logo/geometria.py by logo/gerar.py. Symbol groups are marked with data-pf-symbol and data-pf-box; the generator rewrites their contents on every run, so never hand-edit the symbol inside a template. For trademark-critical production the open item is provenance, not drawing quality — see logo/SOURCE-STATUS.md.
shared_rules: Use the approved logo master. Do not redraw or approximate it.
Use POWERFARM Black and Cream as the dominant pair.
Use Energy Amber only for emphasis and wayfinding.
Keep one dominant message per application surface.
Follow the layout grid instead of free-positioning elements.
Use real or approved POWERFARM imagery.
Respect substrate, print, fabrication, accessibility, and regulatory constraints.
